name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt; pass reference_images (array of image paths) for image-to-image. Uses the configured OpenAI image API. On messaging platforms a reference must be an image attached this turn, a context_image_N from chat history, or a trusted avatar URL. Returns the local path of the generated image. Delivery differs by host: follow the assistant_instruction field in the result. On messaging platforms images are not delivered automatically and must be sent with send_message_to_user; local sessions display them automatically.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images for image-to-image. Each value takes the same forms as vision_analyze's image: a local image path, an http(s) image URL, or a context_image_N from the chat history.
